description: Deterministic finance calculators in one dispatch endpoint. POST `{ function, params }` where function ∈ {black_scholes, implied_volatility, kelly, sharpe, sortino, max_drawdown, historical_var, cvar, cagr, volatility}. e.g. black_scholes params {S,K,T,r,sigma,type}; kelly {p,b}; sharpe {returns[],rf?}. Unpaid: free while the caller's IP has free-trial calls left that day (a small daily allowance shared across the trial stalls, no wallet); otherwise returns 402. Flat-priced per request. (PAID x402 service — USDC on Base; the MCP server needs a funded wallet to settle.) Price: $0.003 USD (fixed).
name: quant
